article_title: Azure MCP Server 3.0 升级清单与只读上手
core_theme: Azure MCP Server 3.0 稳定版把 Backup、Resilience、SRE Agent、Terraform 等真正的运维工具交给 AI agent，同时带来一批必须先处理的工具契约、响应结构、配置键名与协议变更。
reader_takeaway: 理解 agent 已从「查看资源」进入「执行运维」，并知道升级前要先按清单重接口、再用只读模式验证。
summary_angle: 从「只能看」到「能真的动手」，但动手之前必须先换接口：一张封面里同时表达工具箱变大和接口需要重新适配。

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: an AI agent has just received a much larger set of real Azure operational tools, but the interfaces must be re-fitted before any of them can be used. The reader should quickly feel that the agent moved from merely inspecting resources to actually performing maintenance work, and that the upgrade comes with a concrete re-fitting checklist.

Summary angle: from "can only look" to "can actually operate", with a visible re-fitting cost before use.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three clearly separated supporting narrative beats.

Focal subject: a weathered heavy industrial toolbox with a hinged lid standing open wide on a scarred work platform, filled with many distinct rugged work tools. It is the single dominant focal object, slightly off center to the left.

Beat 1 (evidence, upper left): the open toolbox lid, revealing a noticeably larger set of distinct rugged tools inside. Small weathered label on the lid reads 新工具.
Beat 2 (contrast, center): beside the toolbox, a dusty pile of discarded old connectors and worn couplings with a few faded blank nameplates scattered in the dirt. Small weathered label above the pile reads 契约变更.
Beat 3 (takeaway, upper right): a safety-railed inspection catwalk with only a single observation hatch open, no cutting or repair action engaged, only inspection. Small weathered label reads 只读起步.

A compact rugged field-maintenance unit (small industrial machine, not a heroic humanoid hero) leans over the right side of the toolbox as if actively re-fitting a coupling. Keep it secondary and low, never the main focal point.

Composition/framing: single dominant focal object, diagonal thrust from lower-left to upper-right through three clearly separated beats, wide horizontal storytelling, generous negative space, no clutter.

Style/medium: combine product-poster style illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: post-apocalyptic wasteland illustration, weathered materials, dusty atmosphere, survival objects, desaturated contrast. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as a summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.

Color palette: dust ochre and weathered brown, faded safety orange, cool iron grey, one restrained cyan indicator accent.

Visible text policy: allow exactly three short Chinese labels and nothing else: 新工具, 契约变更, 只读起步. Each is at most 6 Chinese characters. Absolutely no other text, glyphs, engravings, carved symbols, runes or fake markings anywhere in the image. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.

Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.

Avoid: neon skyscrapers, code rain, generic humanoid robot hero poses, HUD overlays, cyberpunk purple-blue glow, floating chips, real dashboards, real terminal output.
